sections.title: Sound of the letter pe
paragraphs: The letter (pe) /pe/ makes the sound /p/. You hear it in (pan) /ˈpan/, which means bread. This letter has only one sound in Spanish.

sections.title: How to say pe
paragraphs: Close both lips firmly to block the air. Then open your lips quickly to release the air. Your vocal cords do not vibrate. Hold your hand in front of your lips to feel almost no breath.

sections.title: Spelling of pe
paragraphs: The letter (pe) /pe/ always makes the sound /p/. It sounds the same in every position, as in the word (copa) /ˈko.pa/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid with pe
paragraphs: Do not blow out a puff of air. In English words like pin, a burst of breath follows the lips opening. Release your lips gently so no puff comes out.
